title: Migration header comment misdescribes the shipped erasure and token-mint design
evidence:
--   * Erasure — the continue email carries a self-service delete link
--     (POST /apply/:code/draft-erasure/:token) that removes the row.
...
-- continue_token is 288 bits of URL-safe entropy (wisp.random_string(48)),
-- same capability model as application.erasure_token: the token IS the
-- auth. Partial unique index — most rows have NULL (token minted lazily on
-- the first "email me a link" request).
detail: Both statements are stale vs the shipped design: erase_draft_by_token.sql tombstones ("tombstone, NOT a hard delete") and the file's own erased_at comment agrees; tokens mint at SAVE (upsert_application_draft.sql: "minted at SAVE time"), so most rows will NOT have NULL. Migrations are immutable once merged — last chance to fix.
recommended_fix: Before merge, edit the header to say erasure tombstones (fields/token wiped, email kept as suppression record until vacancy close) and that tokens mint at save time.

title: DOMContentLoaded bootstrap passes the Event object as `env`, silently disabling the saver on that path
detail: As a listener, initBrowser receives the Event as env; Event has no .document so it returns before activating. Unreachable today (both script tags are defer → readyState 'interactive'), failure direction is safe, but the sibling files' arg-less initBrowser has no such trap and _initBrowser tests never exercise the listener path.

title: Applicant-facing copy lives in two places with comment-only sync; the Gleam half is dead code
detail: The five form_copy.gleam constants (draft_prep_note, draft_continue_*) are referenced by no SSR render — grep shows only a comment in form_view.gleam:124 uses the name. Strings match today, but no test pins Gleam↔JS equality, and the repo already has a single-source pattern: SSR-emitted data-* attributes read by form.js's upload preflight.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as-is per REVIEW_HINT_STEPPER precedent; if touched again, prefer emitting the strings as data-* attributes on the prep block so form_copy.gleam is the real source, or pin equality in a test.
